signed_rows.behavior: Both Hermes workflows start on /hermes or /triage from a member, and no workflow or prompt says @hermes
signed_rows.fails_when: hermes-interactive.yaml's trigger_phrase or job condition is not /hermes, either job runs for a comment from someone outside MEMBER, OWNER or COLLABORATOR, or '@hermes' appears in either workflow or prompt

signed_rows.behavior: hermes-interactive.yaml reads its prompt and skills from the default branch, never from the pull request
signed_rows.fails_when: system_prompt_file or skills_dir points outside the checkout of the default branch

signed_rows.behavior: Every action in both Hermes workflows is pinned by commit SHA
signed_rows.fails_when: a uses: line in either workflow names a tag or branch instead of a 40-character SHA with its version comment
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_workflows.py -k 'pinned_by_commit_sha and hermes' -q

signed_rows.behavior: scripts/hermes_triage.py cuts a triage comment longer than 800 characters (about 200 tokens) at a line break and keeps it at most 800 characters
signed_rows.fails_when: a 2000-character response is posted longer than 800 characters, or is cut in the middle of a line

signed_rows.behavior: scripts/hermes_triage.py applies only allowed labels and the priority label from the trailer, and strips the trailer from the comment
signed_rows.fails_when: a label outside the type, area/* or priority/* lists is applied, the priority label is missing, or the trailer appears in the posted comment

signed_rows.behavior: The triage system prompt asks for a comment under 200 tokens, and the workflow's area labels match kmctl's top-level layout
signed_rows.fails_when: issue-triage-system.md does not state the 200-token limit, or TRIAGE_AREAS names a folder kmctl does not have
signed_rows.command: uv run pytest tests/scripts/test_hermes_triage.py -k 'prompt or areas' -q

signed_rows.behavior: An ADR records why kmctl's repository runs Hermes for /hermes and triage beside action/agent.py, which ADR 0017 chose for the audit
signed_rows.fails_when: no accepted ADR covers the Hermes workflows, or it contradicts ADR 0017's audit decision
